# QuickCode

QuickCode creates QR codes whose destinations can be edited after printing. Static QR codes work without an account; dynamic QR codes route through a QuickCode redirect and record only a timestamped scan count.

## Key links
- Home: https://quickcode.io/
- Generator: https://quickcode.io/generator
- Pricing: https://quickcode.io/pricing
- About: https://quickcode.io/about
- Restaurant menus: https://quickcode.io/qr-code-for/restaurant-menu
- WiFi sharing: https://quickcode.io/qr-code-for/wifi
- Business cards: https://quickcode.io/qr-code-for/business-card
- Wedding invitations: https://quickcode.io/qr-code-for/wedding
- Real estate signs: https://quickcode.io/qr-code-for/real-estate-sign
- Event check-in: https://quickcode.io/qr-code-for/event-ticket
- Product packaging: https://quickcode.io/qr-code-for/product-packaging

## Privacy
QuickCode does not collect personal or device-identifying scan data. Scan logs contain a count and timestamp only.
